name: yq-7862131c-blind28-ots
instr:
# yq answers everyday expressions wrongly across the board, to be diagnosed without a test suite

After picking up a fresh build of this tool, a great many routine expressions answer wrongly. The repository has received 28 separate undocumented edits. Everything below is what we can see from the outside, with no obvious pattern to it.

Simply asking the tool to describe what it has matched now produces silence. Asking what type each match is — a mapping, a list, a plain value — prints no output whatsoever, for any document, including the little how-to examples in our own write-ups. Asking which row of the original text a value came from is the same story: empty output where we used to get a position. Asking whether the thing matched is the name half of a pair rather than the value half also yields nothing, and expressions that ask that question first and then read an attached annotation come back empty too. Randomly reordering the entries of a list returns an empty result instead of the reordered entries, and a couple of removal expressions that route through the same reordering are wrong as well.

Turning text into a numeric value is broken from two directions at once. Quoted digits are handed straight back, still text, unchanged, while a value that is already numeric is now rejected with a complaint that it cannot be turned into one at all.
